==See Also==
*'''[[Assets in GTA San Andreas|Assets]]''': Assets generally do not provide any services, but rather feature a [[Money]] collection point where you can collect money each day.
*'''[[Barbers]]''': The Barbers allow you to choose what kind of hairstyle you would like [[Carl Johnson]] to have.
*'''[[Clothing Stores in GTA San Andreas|Clothing Stores]]''': Clothing Stores offer a variety of clothes for purchase.
*'''[[Gyms]]''': Gyms allow Carl to shed [[Fat]] and build up [[Statistics|Muscle]] and [[Statistics|Stamina]].
*'''[[Restaurants in GTA San Andreas|Restaurants]]''': Restaurants offer food for Carl.
*'''[[Mod Garages]]''': Mod Garages offer different types of modifications for certain [[Vehicles in GTA San Andreas|vehicles]].
*'''[[Tattoo Parlors]]''': Tattoo Parlors allow you to choose from many designs to tattoo Carl.
